ev.q: The median age of workers was 30 years (range = 15–56 years), and most spoke only Spanish.
This cluster of influenza A(H5) cases in a predominantly Spanish-speaking migrant workforce highlights the importance of a public health response that prioritizes health equity.
The median age was 32 years (range = 18–56 years).

notes: Comparisons are descriptive: positivity and PPE use by facility, and symptoms by H5 test result (Table 2), with no tests or CIs. Medians of incubation and symptom duration are descriptive and not compared, so continuous is not listed. Laboratory RT-PCR only confirms case status.
